communication_seed.first_comment: Boundaries aren't meant to be understood, you just have to respect it. We all different people who live life differently and want different things for our kids. I grew up where we don't need to understand eachother Boundaries e.g my sister doesn't like her things moved it needs to be a certain way and in a certain colour coordination. Do i understand it? NO do i do the same? No but its ain't rocket science just don't do it.

literally lol the kiss and hug thing. i always say "do you want to be kissed and hugged all the time by people? no. so stop thinking because she's a baby/kid she wants it"

@zainab_dudley family and friends think they are entitled. I think theres a problem with you if you can't respect someone elses boundaries. Cause honestly i dont care if the previous generation kissed babies they probably did cause the prev gen did it too....even if i have a rule with my toddler or newborn or teen just respect it. As moms we the villian anyways so have that boundary you wont regret it.
